requirement_vague: Deleting a todo removes it from the database
requirement_precise: Register a user and login. Create a todo with title 'Todo to Delete' and note the ID. Call DELETE /todos/{id}. Verify the response status is 200 OK. Then call GET /todos/{id} and verify the response is 404 Not Found (todo no longer exists).

implementation.location: DELETE /todos/{id} in delete_todo, and GET /todos/{id} in get_todo
implementation.reasoning: The DELETE handler looks up the todo for the authenticated user, deletes it from the database with session.delete(todo), and commits the transaction. The GET handler queries by id and user_id and returns 404 when no matching todo exists, so after deletion the todo is no longer retrievable.
